behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd, src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/IndexedConnector.cs#SelectSequentialRecord) decides only which record §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18 selects for a READ PREVIOUS that is the first operation after OPEN on an indexed file. A syntax rule on the KEY phrase, checked at compile time; the switch acts at run time on format 1 PREVIOUS only. No change. Lead, not this row: at --std 2002 the switch returns the lowest record (probe prev-open-ix.cob: P1=K002|00) where §2002:14.8.26.3 GR12 (FPI = lowest-ordinal characters) with §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18c2 (key less than or equal to the FPI) find no record, so '10' and at end; that is a GR18 defect.
